subject: Amplify Weekly | 11/13 | Transcribe Tips, Follow-Up Prompts, Matching News

blocks.text: Two weeks in one this time! This issue covers our Transcribe launch on 11/3 and last Tuesday’s Open Lab. Skim the headers and grab what’s useful.

blocks.title: ⚠️ Heads up on Transcribe
blocks.text: Right now it seems to only be picking up your side of the call. The transcript and summary aren’t capturing what the traveler says. Big thanks to Renee for catching this! I’m working on it with our Bullhorn AI advisor. Until it’s fixed, keep jotting down the important stuff your traveler tells you the way you normally would.

blocks.title: Matching is coming
blocks.text: Bullhorn confirmed we already have their Search & Match tool. It just was never set up. Once it’s on, every job order gets a “recommended candidates” card that explains why each person is a fit.

items: KPI prompt: it counts the same candidate more than once. Stick with the morning report until I fix it.
Can’t do yet: Amplify can’t create a new candidate from a pasted conversation.
Start: click Record Now on the traveler’s record.
Stop: click Stop & Process when you hang up.

blocks.text: 🎤 Always tell people you’re recording. “Just so you know, I’m recording this so I can take good notes.”
Let Amplify handle your weekly follow-ups
Run one of these in Amplify Chat on Monday morning:
Go through anyone I reached out to or made a note on last week and let me know what I need to follow up on.

items: Run one follow-up prompt Monday and turn the list into tasks.
Pick your pickiest traveler, build their prompt, and save it.
Keep job alerts broad so you don’t miss jobs with bad data.
Keep them specific for your needle-in-a-haystack travelers.
Renee runs saved prompts daily that search past Bullhorn’s 100-mile radius limit.

blocks.text: A referral built his whole profile through My Atlas Access before I even called him.
